deadline.value: The Math department's own pages say December 1, 11:59 PM EST (the OGE directory lists December 15); apply by December 1 to be safe. Fee-waiver requests are due November 20, 2026.
deadline.quote: The application filing deadline is December 1, for matriculation in September.

also.quote: Fill out the on-line application by 23:59, EST, December 1.
Fee waiver applications are due before the application deadline: November 20, 2026
Deadline: December 15 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time

gre_general.value: GRE General is optional; it will not hurt you if omitted.
gre_general.quote: GRE general/subject scores are optional. We will accept scores if submitted but it will not negatively influence your application if not included.

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics Subject GRE is optional, but it is the score the department is most interested in if you send one.
gre_subject.quote: Submitting GRE scores is entirely optional: We will accept scores if submitted (and are most interested in the Math Subject test result, if any) but it will not hurt your application if not included.

supervisor.value: The department pages checked do not say whether contacting a supervisor is needed; short-listed applicants interview with a faculty committee in January.

funding.value: Five years of full support (tuition, stipend, health cover) for students making satisfactory progress; first year on full fellowship.
funding.quote: Financial support is guaranteed for five years to students making satisfactory progress. Students receive full tuition, a stipend, and individual health coverage.

entry_route.value: No master's degree needed; a bachelor's (or equivalent) is required.
entry_route.quote: Do I need a master's degree before applying? No, a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) is required.

notes: Statistics: MIT has no standalone statistics PhD admission. The Interdisciplinary Doctoral Program in Statistics (IDPS) gives an 'Interdisciplinary PhD in Mathematics and Statistics' (also with Physics, BCS, MechE, Aero/Astro, IDSS-SES and others); students already enrolled in a participating PhD join it via a selection form after their second semester. IELTS is the preferred English test.
